intro: Nigerian culture is famous worldwide for Afrobeats music, Nollywood films and great writers.

chapters.title: Music and books
text: Fela Kuti created Afrobeat; today Afrobeats stars like Burna Boy, Wizkid and Tems fill stadiums worldwide. Wole Soyinka was the first African to win the Nobel Prize for Literature, and Chinua Achebe's Things Fall Apart is one of the most read African novels.

chapters.title: Food
text: Jollof rice (and friendly arguments with Ghana about whose is best), egusi soup, suya and pounded yam are favourites.
